title: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane

sources.title: Silver Sword of the Astral Plane

summary: Githyanki greatsword with Soulbreaker and conditional Psychic damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 2d6 + 3 Slashing plus Strength. Martial, two-handed, heavy, dippable, 5 ft melee. Enchantment also applies to attacks.
fields.Soulbreaker: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage plus proficiency bonus Psychic. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Stunned for 2 turns.
fields.Lacerate: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Bleeding for 2 turns. Bleeding deals 2 Slashing at turn start and gives disadvantage on Constitution saves. Healing ends it. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.
fields.Pommel Strike: Bonus Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning melee attack. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity bonus to AC, blocks reactions and gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Help ends it. No main-hand weapon functors.
fields.Cleave: Action with proficiency, once per Short Rest. Attack up to 3 targets in a 7 ft cone for half weapon damage. Flat damage bonuses such as Rage are not halved.
fields.Githborn Psionics: A Githyanki wielder adds 1d6 Psychic on hit, has Psychic resistance and advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves, and is immune to the Charmed status group.
fields.Acquisition: Show Voss the Orphic Hammer, defeat him, or succeed at his DC 30 deception route. An Act One disarm can yield it early but precludes a second quest copy.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
